prompt: Why has the association not yet formally applied?

options.zh: 場地所有人拒絕提供許可
options.whyZh: 館長已簽許可，承辦人接受。

options.text: The group requested too little money
It has only emailed a draft
options.whyZh: 只有透過線上申請系統送出才是正式申請，單寄草稿不算。

options.zh: 施工日期超出允許期間
